programs.description: As Anwar witnesses Babri Masjid demolition, he takes up the extremist path and turns into a jihadi. Due to this, his family suffers a lot of problems and struggles to overcome the obstacles.
Madhavan is loved and respected by everyone in the village except his brothers who hate him. Matters get worse after his brothers try to falsely implicate him in an acquaintance's murder case.
Rishi is a diligent collector who works honestly for the good of people. However, things take a turn after he draws the attention of corrupt politicians and businessmen who want to cause trouble.
Renuka leads a happy life with her husband, Appu. However, Preman, a womaniser, ends their marital bliss when he creates problems in their lives.
Prabhakaran, a Gandhian panchayat member, fights corruption in Thonnurkara village. However, his crusade for people's welfare angers corrupt politicians.
The lives of peaceful fishermen living on the western coast of Kerala change when a stranger with ulterior motives visits their village for business.
Menon takes the help of a dangerous prisoner, Vikraman, who resembles a policeman, in order to nab a notorious gangster.
As the new caretaker of a palace that is under dispute over its ownership, Anantha, an advocate, must ensure the property remains safe.
A young man who is nursing a broken heart is helped by a friend during his dark times. However, he soon falls in love with another woman.
Kallanum Polisum
Narayanan, a young man, goes to Dubai to make a living. However, he faces many struggles but braves them for the sake of his family's well-being.
Nandakumar, a reporter, is assigned to cover the hapless plight of farmers at Pannakamkudi. Upon seeing their sufferings in person, he decides to help them.

Meera arrives at brothers Chathukutty Bhagavathar and Chandappan Gurukkal's house claiming to be the Bhagavathar's daughter. However, another man reaches the village and insists that he is her father.
Appu's father lies to him that his mother is dead. Devoid of a mother's love, Appu resorts to smoking and drinking until he learns that she is still alive.
Rival fishermen Esthappan and Anto set aside differences when their shared passion for theatre opens doors to experiences beyond their everyday lives.
Kunjunni, an orphan, and Radha, who makes a living by selling statues of deities, love each other. However, problems arise when her father opposes their relationship.
Appukuttan falls in love with Sarojini, who does not reciprocate his feelings. Things take a dramatic turn when Sarojini is found murdered and Appukuttan is implicated in the crime.
When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess, but he is not what he claims to be.
